title: Seat Orders
statement: A dinner table has one chair per guest. Guests are given as distinct numbers. Return every order in which they can sit, in lexicographic order.

keyPoints: Sort the guests so orders come out lexicographically
At each chair, try every unused guest
Record when every chair is filled
Undo: free the guest after exploring
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Generate orders with next-permutation from the sorted list: same output, O(n · n!)

hints: Each chair can take any guest not yet seated. What do you need to remember?
Which guests are already seated: a used array.
Sort first; for each chair try guests in order, mark used, recurse, then unmark.
